calls.title: Growthbook <> Cyera - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne, sales; Logan Bates, solutions engineering; Graham, founder) met with Cyera (Barak Loudvinovsky, team lead; Asaf Hizki, software engineer) to discuss replacing Cyera’s internal Boolean-only feature flag solution. Cyera needs granular user-based targeting, SDKs, A/B testing, FedRAMP compliance, edge deployment for customer-cloud environments, and multiple data region support. Next steps: a demo call scheduled for Tuesday the 17th, and Daniel will follow up with documentation and pricing details.
